items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: Smoky Joe to go out there. Smoky Joe to go out there.

ctx.x: I used to do the last time they put them in the water, the camps out there. They had a great ground fall, you know, when the water, people go swimming. Every Sunday, every barn house is packed.
Smoky Joe to go out there. Smoky Joe to go out there.

They have all other things to eat and drink with. And they want that provision. How about provision that they are? And most of the doctors and teachers, they give them thinking. They come by law and this is my name. This is my heart of education. They're all about it.
